usage: run_terminal_wsl.py [-h] (--check-imports | --execute)
                           [--saved-home SAVED_HOME]
                           [--connection-id CONNECTION_ID] [--model MODEL]
                           [--distribution DISTRIBUTION] [--user USER]
                           [--expected-uid EXPECTED_UID]
                           [--interop-helper INTEROP_HELPER] [--socket SOCKET]
                           [--port PORT] [--admin-role ADMIN_ROLE]
                           [--runtime-role RUNTIME_ROLE]
                           [--root-database ROOT_DATABASE]
                           [--expected-data EXPECTED_DATA]
                           [--expected-system-id EXPECTED_SYSTEM_ID]
                           [--scratch-root SCRATCH_ROOT] [--cases CASES]
                           [--output OUTPUT]

Output-only adapter for the existing terminal dogfood; no provider on
help/imports. Run with the installed Linux Python and current repository tests
on sys.path. The caller supplies a previously approved disposable Unix-socket
PostgreSQL. This adapter never starts/stops/resets that cluster or writes
saved settings.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --check-imports
  --execute             Actually call the saved provider
  --saved-home SAVED_HOME
  --connection-id CONNECTION_ID
  --model MODEL
  --distribution DISTRIBUTION
  --user USER
  --expected-uid EXPECTED_UID
  --interop-helper INTEROP_HELPER
  --socket SOCKET
  --port PORT
  --admin-role ADMIN_ROLE
  --runtime-role RUNTIME_ROLE
  --root-database ROOT_DATABASE
  --expected-data EXPECTED_DATA
  --expected-system-id EXPECTED_SYSTEM_ID
  --scratch-root SCRATCH_ROOT
  --cases CASES
  --output OUTPUT
